summary.text: Dylan Germana is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the September 8 Democratic primary.
He previously represented Cheshire 1 in the House from 2024 until he resigned on January 30, 2026, and he holds an at-large seat on the Keene School District board.

paragraphs.text: Germana lives in Keene, attended Keene State College, and his career experience includes working as a market leader for Jersey Mike's.

Ballotpedia lists him as winning the November 2024 general election for Cheshire 1, in which he was unopposed on the ballot, succeeding Nicholas Germana, and as holding the Keene School District at-large seat since 2024 with a term ending in 2027.
